resources.string: Save any WhatsApp status in one tap
A few quick taps and you\'re set — the green button then lives inside WhatsApp, ready whenever you are.
Quick setup — tap Allow for each step

This lets StatusSaver put its green button inside WhatsApp. Tap Allow, then in the list tap \"StatusSaver smart button\", switch it ON, and come back here. It only notices which app is open — it cannot read your messages or anything on screen.

WhatsApp keeps the statuses you view in a hidden folder. Tap Allow and switch \"Allow access to manage all files\" ON, so StatusSaver can save the status you\'re watching. It reads only WhatsApp\'s status folders — nothing else.
Some phones quietly switch background apps off — that is what made the button disappear before. Tap Allow and choose \"Allow\" so the button stays alive.

Some phones hide one more switch — \"Autostart\" — that decides whether StatusSaver may wake up on its own after a restart, without you opening it first. If your phone has it, turn it ON for StatusSaver. No such switch on your phone? Just tap Done below — you won\'t be asked again.
OK — you can still change Autostart later in your phone\'s app settings
You\'re all set ✓ — open WhatsApp and look for the green button.

Your phone put the button\'s engine to sleep, so there\'s no button in WhatsApp right now. Tap Wake it, then switch \"StatusSaver smart button\" OFF and back ON (even if it already shows ON — that\'s what wakes it). That\'s the whole fix — no full setup again.
Shows the StatusSaver download button while WhatsApp is open, so you can save the status you are viewing in one tap. It detects which app window is open only — it does not read screen content.
Turn on Accessibility first (Step 1 above) — the watcher IS the button engine
One moment — the button engine isn\'t connected yet. If this message stays, redo Step 1 above.
Open a status first, then tap the green button.
When ON, any status you open in WhatsApp saves itself — no tapping needed.
Auto-save ON — statuses you view will save themselves
